entry.eyebrow: A LITTLE WORLD OF WORK AND IDEAS
entry.heading: MIXING THE INK
entry.description: Welcome to Sky Street — an interactive journey through projects, ideas, and creative engineering.

about.heading: ABOUT ME
paragraphs: Hello! I am a creative developer who builds expressive, responsive, and performance-minded digital experiences.
I explore the intersection of 3D computer graphics, interface design, and front-end engineering to bring imaginative ideas to life.

items.summary: Building modern interactive web experiences, real-time shaders, and scalable frontend architectures.
highlights: Developed high-performance 3D web applications with seamless mobile responsiveness.
Collaborated closely with design and engineering teams to ship award-worthy digital products.

items.summary: Crafted design systems, micro-interactions, and accessible web interfaces.
highlights: Optimized runtime WebGL frame rates and bundle sizes across lower-power mobile devices.
Implemented comprehensive keyboard navigation and WCAG accessibility patterns.

items.summary: Creative frontend development and digital prototyping.
highlights: Created interactive 2D/3D landing pages and custom motion graphics.
Established automated testing and modern deployment workflows.

projects.title: WAVE SHADERS
projects.description: An interactive study into custom vertex shaders, mathematical wave interference, and toon material reflections in Three.js.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Wave Shaders project featuring colorful procedural spheres

projects.title: KINETIC TYPOGRAPHY
projects.description: An experimental type playground exploring vector field distortions, mouse-reactive typography, and physics-driven letterform scattering.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Kinetic Typography project showing warped stylized letterforms

projects.title: NEON OASIS
projects.description: A scroll-choreographed 3D walk through futuristic structures featuring real-time bloom lighting and audio-responsive volumetric fog.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Neon Oasis project with stylized glowing skyscrapers

projects.title: ORBITAL SOUNDSCAPE
projects.description: A Web Audio and WebGL synthesizer where planetary orbits trigger polyphonic harmonies and synchronized particle pulses.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Orbital Soundscape with intersecting planetary rings

projects.title: CHROMA ENGINE
projects.description: A developer tool designed to generate accessible, WCAG-compliant color schemes and preview them live across simulated UI components.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Chroma Engine color swatch interface

projects.title: MINIMAL CANVAS
projects.description: An ultra-lean 2KB JavaScript utility for creating particle systems, trails, and fluid grid effects without heavy external dependencies.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Minimal Canvas particle geometry

projects.title: ISOMETRIC ISLE
projects.tagline: Interactive miniature diorama with seasonal weather
projects.description: A charming low-poly island world with toggleable day-to-night lighting, falling snow, rain particles, and cozy ambient soundscapes.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Isometric Isle diorama with cozy cabins and pine trees

projects.title: HYPERDRIVE UI
projects.description: A responsive HUD concept featuring custom SVG gauges, animated radar sweeps, coordinate readouts, and fluid state transitions.
projects.imageAlt: Visual preview of Hyperdrive UI showing sci-fi telemetry gauges
